data.exact_reserve_text: Calculated from the gross claims development table on page 17, summing the changes in current estimates versus previous diagonals for underwriting years 2012 to 2016.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 1.91 million in 2018, calculated from the claims development triangle. This indicates that prior period reserves were found to be slightly insufficient. The report attributes reserve movements to factors such as future experience being more adverse than assumed, inherent uncertainty in estimation, and potential deviations from past trends. Other contributing factors include once-off occurrences, changes in market factors, public attitude to claiming, economic conditions, judicial decisions, government legislation, variation in interest rates, delays in settlement, and changes in foreign currency rates. The strengthening affected underwriting years 2012 to 2016.
